summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-enum with the eleven members from the spec. botocore/args.py makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults, which composes the bridge's variant and DualStack lookups and the existing S3/STS predicates. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins covering each behavioral criterion. Test results: test_args.py, test_regions.py, test_client.py, test_utils.py and test_endpoint.py pass (722 tests). A full tests/unit run exited 0 in the background, but its pytest summary was not captured. Nothing is committed. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is returned as None when absent so all eleven keys are present.
